subject: MedSync — security intake & SIG initiation (post-demo action items)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsync.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: MedSync — security intake & SIG initiation (post-demo action items)

Hi Lena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and recommended next steps from our side so we can get your security team what they need to move forward: 

Summary from demo:
- You confirmed MedSync will evaluate Redwood for document ingestion and summarized PII/PHI patterns (care notes + patient IDs).
- Primary compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II evidence, data residency for US-only, HIPAA BA considerations, and encryption at-rest/in-transit.

Requested next steps (what Redwood can do):
1) Start SIG + CAIQ prefill for fastest path to vendor attestation. I’ve attached our prefill workbook (redwood_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx) with high-level answers we can prefill — please flag anything that looks off.
2) Clarify which questionnaire you prefer: full SIG (consortium SIG), CAIQ-lite, or your custom security intake form. If it’s custom, send the template and we’ll map fields.
3) Timeline ask: you mentioned a 2–3 week security review window for preferred vendors. Can you confirm target date for final sign-off?

Clarifying questions for MedSync security team (quick list for your intake):
- Is HIPAA Business Associate Agreement required now or only upon POC?
- Are there any additional evidence items beyond SOC2 (e.g., penetration test report, vulnerability scan results) that you expect up-front?
- For data residency: do you need a contract clause restricting processing to US regions, or is a controls attestation sufficient?

What I’m attaching: redwood_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx (short prefill workbook) and our Redwood Security Factsheet (PDF).

If useful, I can schedule a short 30-min walkthrough with your security reviewer to go through the prefill and map answers — available tomorrow morning (Fri) or Monday.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx (workbook, 8 pages summary)
Attachment: redwood-security-factsheet.pdf (1 page)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsync.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: medsync-security@medsync.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedSync — security intake & SIG initiation (post-demo action items)

Thanks, Priya — appreciated the clear recap. A few quick answers and notes from our end: 

- Preferred questionnaire: start with the SIG Lite (we use SIG Lite + a small custom addendum for PHI handling). If you can prefill the SIG Lite and then we’ll drop in our addendum, that’s ideal.
- HIPAA BAA: required before any production data; for the POC we can work under a narrow scoped BAA or Data Processing Addendum — we’ll confirm the exact wording.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report is required; we typically ask for the last 12 months of pen test summary and remediations. Full pen test artifacts not required unless red flags.
- Data residency: controls attestation is okay, but contract language preferred at negotiation time.

Timeline: target is vendor approval in ~3 weeks from today (by 2027-03-05). Security team available for a 30-min walkthrough on Monday 2027-02-15 at 10:00am PT.

I’ve copied our security inbox for logistics. I’ll also upload the SIG Lite template to the shared drive once I’m back at my desk.

Lena Ortiz
Head of Vendor Risk, MedSync
Lena.Oritz@medsync.com

--
